SJS Response Event

Background

The Mini Program with frequent user interaction may respond slowly. For example, a page has two elements A and B. When a user performs a touchmove gesture on A, B is required to move along with A. The response process for a touchmove event is as follows:

a. The touchmove event is thrown from the view layer (view) to the logical layer (service).

b. The logical layer (service) processes the touchmove event and changes the position of B through setData.

A response to touchmove involves two rounds of communication between the logic layer and the rendering layer as well as a rendering, which is time consuming.

In addition, setData rendering blocks the execution of other scripts. All this delays the interactive animation process. To support this rich interaction scenario, the number of communication rounds must be reduced to allow event response at the view layer. SJS functions can respond to events of basic components without data update, directly drive changes of view elements such as styles and class names, and query element layouts.

How to Use

Event Callback

Input Parameter

Parameter Explain
event event object
ownerInstance Indicates the ComponentDescriptor instance of the component that triggers the event. If the component that triggers the event is on a page, ownerInstance indicates the page instance.

The ownerInstance is defined as follows:

Method Parameter Description
selectComponent selector object Returns the ComponentDescriptor instance of the component.
selectAllComponents Selector object array Returns an array of ComponentDescriptor instances of the component.
setStyle Object/string Sets the component style. RPX is supported. The configured style has a higher priority than the style defined in the maml component. The style of the topmost page cannot be set.
addClass/removeClass/hasClass String Set the class of the component. The priority of the class is higher than that of the class defined in the maml component. The class of the top-level page cannot be set.
getDataset none Returns the dataset object of the current component or page.
callMethod (funcName:string, args:object) Invoke the functions defined by the current component or page at the logical layer (service). funcName indicates the function name, and args indicates the parameter of the function.

The SJS runs at the view layer. The logic in the SJS can perform only a few events. Therefore, a mechanism is required to communicate with the code of the service layer developer. The callMethod is a method for invoking the code of the service layer developer in the SJS.

Restrictions on use

  • Only events of built-in components can be responded. Events of customized components and native components are not supported.

Example

// common.sjs
/**
 * Slider calculation position
 */
var starLeft = 0;
var starTop = 0;
var starX = 0;
var starY = 0;
function liveTouchmove(event, ownerInstance) {
  var left = 0,
    top = 0;
  var diffX = 0,
    diffY = 0;
  if (event.type === 'touchstart') {
    starLeft = event.currentTarget.offsetLeft;
    starTop = event.currentTarget.offsetTop;
    starX = event.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    starY = event.changedTouches[0].clientY;
    left = starLeft;
    top = starTop;
  } else {
    diffX = event.changedTouches[0].clientX - starX;
    diffY = event.changedTouches[0].clientY - starY;
    left = starLeft + diffX;
    top = starTop + diffY;
  }
  left = left + 'px';
  var instance = ownerInstance.selectComponent('.liveMove'); // //Return the component instance.
  instance.callMethod('callMe', { top: { top: { top: top, aa: '1' }, bb: '222' }, call: [1, 2, 3] });
  instance.setStyle({
    left: left,
    top: top + 'px'
  });
}

/**
 * Click the live broadcast entry.
 * @param
 */
function clickLive(event, ownerInstance) {
  ownerInstance.callMethod('bindEnter');
}
module.exports = {
  liveTouchmove: liveTouchmove,
  clickLive: clickLive
};

<sjs module="comm" src="../../../util/common.sjs"></sjs>
<view
  class="enterLive liveMove"
  style="top:202px;left:100px"
  bind:touchstart="{{comm.liveTouchmove}}"
  bind:touchmove="{{comm.liveTouchmove}}"
  bind:touchend="{{comm.liveTouchmove}}"
>
  <view class="live-block" bind:tap="{{comm.clickLive}}">
    <image
      class="liveEnter-img"
      mode="aspectFit"
      src="https://img0.baidu.com/it/u=401284325,23907343&fm=26&fmt=auto&gp=0.jpg"
    />
  </view>
</view>
